name: bmae-plataforma
description: Plataforma BMAE — ERPNext v15 + Twenty + SPA. Monorepo Python+TS+JS vainilla (prompt maestro unificado).

scripts.test: python3 -m pytest motor/ verifactu/ integracion/ auth/ diseno/tests limpieza -q && cd diseno/componentes && node --test tests-componentes.test.mjs && cd ../../frontend-auth && node --test tests/
scripts.clean: find . -name __pycache__ -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name '*.egg-info' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; rm -rf .pytest_cache motor/.pytest_cache diseno/.pytest_cache
scripts.verify: npm run test:limpieza && npm run export:check
